blocks.html: Where an appliance, equipment or insulation is subject to water damage when auxiliary drain pans fill, that portion of the appliance, equipment or insulation shall be installed above the rim of the pans. Supports located inside of the pans to support the appliance or equipment or insulation shall be water resistant and approved.
